newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel shares gains on Cofira sale.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel shares gains on Cofira sale.

text.p: Shares in Alcatel Alsthom were sharply higher on Thursday afternoon, buoyed by the announcement that it had sold its 25 percent stake in Cofira.
"That was very positive and puts the group back in the saddle," a broker said.

The market also liked Chairman Serge Tchuruk's message on Thursday -- he said the group narrowed its first-half loss, should break even this year and show a profit of several billion francs if capital gains are included, because of the Cofira sale.
The stock was up 2.1 percent at 409.5 francs at 1408 GMT.
